_comment: icraft #35 Cataclysm boss-only Tetra material (refight-to-repair). REPAIR ITEM = cataclysm:cursium_ingot, which drops ONLY from Maledictus (cursed_pyramid, T3). Cursium is a cursed-ender themed metal: high primary, deliberately LOW durability (900) so the item wears down -- and since cursium_ingot has no other source, the ONLY way to repair a cursium-built Tetra item is to refight Maledictus. Mirrors the ancient_metal schema (icraft #57). Tools + armor (metal category serves both).
